what: Row-by-row audit of the shipped Gemini foods 1-300 against USDA SR Legacy 2018-04: does fdc_id match the description, the correct id where the exact description exists, SR values for that id, and which macro fields differ from what shipped. Nothing invented; rows whose description is not an SR Legacy description are flagged for a manual match.
blocked_foods_note: These SR foods cannot be added under strict fdc_id dedupe because a mis-keyed shipped row holds their id. Re-key the shipped rows (correct_fdc_id) and they become addable.
